subject: Portal SAML silent-redirect: browser certificate pinning blocks vendor login
messages:
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@auroratrade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Trouble signing in to supplier portal (blank redirect)

Hi Neha,

We tried to accept the Coupa invite you sent (account: procurement@auroratrade.com) and the browser just goes white and redirects back to our corporate IdP page with no error. Tried Chrome and Edge on Windows — same behavior. No login prompt, no SAML screen. Attached a screenshot of the blank page and the redirect trace I captured.

Can you help unblock this? We need to accept the PO before EOD next week.

Thanks,
Amit Shah
Head of Procurement
Aurora Trade Co.

Attachments: screenshot-blank-redirect.png, saml-debug-log.txt

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@auroratrade.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trouble signing in to supplier portal (blank redirect)

Hi Amit — sorry for the hassle.

Quick checklist while I dig in:
- Can you try the invite link in an incognito window?
- If available, please try from a mobile device (cellular) to rule out your corporate network.
- Can you forward the full request/response headers from the debug trace (looks like you already attached saml-debug-log.txt, that helps).

Two quick notes: we recently rotated an IdP intermediate cert for Coupa SAML. Rarely, strict corporate pinning rules can cause a silent redirect if the browser rejects the chain. If incognito/mobile still fails, I will loop in Platform/SRE and we can temporarily issue a direct provisioning link.

I’ll follow up shortly.

— Neha Kapoor
Sr. Procurement Ops - Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment referenced: screenshot-blank-redirect.png

From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@auroratrade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 07:43:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trouble signing in to supplier portal (blank redirect)

Neha — thanks for the fast reply.

Tried incognito and mobile (iPhone on LTE) — mobile worked briefly but then got the same redirect after SAML POST. Our security team enforces a pinned list of intermediates in the browser image; they flagged the Coupa intermediate cert as unknown and dropped the connection silently. I attached the trace you asked for.

If you can provide a temporary direct activation (magic link) or add a one-off provisioning for procurement@auroratrade.com that would be ideal — our PO sits in pending state. Happy to open a quick call if that helps.

— Amit

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Trouble signing in to supplier portal (blank redirect)

Forwarding — vendor (Aurora Trade) is hitting a silent redirect that looks like certificate pinning on their side. They need to accept a PO; procurement wants this turned around quickly.

Amit attached saml-debug-log.txt and screenshot-blank-redirect.png. Monica — can Platform/SRE check the IdP chain we present for Coupa and confirm whether we have any legacy intermediates still referenced? If vendor cert pinning is the cause, we should either:

1) Generate a short-lived provisioning/magic link for procurement@auroratrade.com so Amit can accept the invite without the SAML redirect; or
2) Coordinate with Coupa IdP to reissue with an intermediate compatible with strict pinning (longer path, but definitive fix).

Ben — FYI from a sales/procurement angle: Aurora is on the PO critical path for next-week go-live. If we send a temporary provisioning link, we should note in the account that this was a manual workaround (audit trail).

Thanks — Neha

--- Original message attached ---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Trouble signing in to supplier portal (blank redirect)

Thanks for the context. I pulled the SAML metadata we publish and the TLS chain used for coupa-login.redwoodinference.com. I don’t see any SHA-1 intermediates; however, there is a new intermediate issued in Oct 2026 that some corporate pin lists haven't whitelisted yet. That aligns with the vendor's observation.

Proposed immediate plan (48-hour window):
- I can create a single-use provisioning token for procurement@auroratrade.com that bypasses the SAML redirect and marks the account as "manually provisioned" in audit logs. Token expires 48 hours after issuance.
- Ops will open a Coupa ticket to request an alternate intermediate or to publish an alternate metadata URL that uses the older intermediate for compatibility (we'll track that as a follow-up).
- Ben: if you confirm procurement sign-off, I’ll issue the token and copy it to Amit over a secure channel.

Before I issue the token — Amit, can you confirm the exact email(s) you need provisioned (procurement@auroratrade.com plus any admin aliases)? Also confirm if you want the account created with immediate PO acceptance enabled.

— Monica Patel
Platform Reliability (Onboarding)
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit.shah@auroratrade.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Portal SAML silent-redirect: browser certificate pinning blocks vendor login

Amit — this is Ben from Redwood procurement/sales. We’re good to proceed with the temporary provisioning so you can accept the PO. Please confirm the two emails to be provisioned (procurement@auroratrade.com, accounts-payable@auroratrade.com) and whether you want PO acceptance enabled now.

Once you confirm, Monica will issue the single-use token and I’ll update the PO status on our side so accounting sees the change. Appreciate the quick responses.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales (Procurement)
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Note: Monica will send the provisioning token securely; we will log the manual action in the account audit for compliance.
